topic: Parts and Functions of the Ears
key_concepts: The ears are the sense organs for hearing
The outer ear or pinna catches sound waves
The ear canal directs sound waves to the middle ear
The eardrum vibrates when sound waves strike it
The hammer, anvil, and stirrup are the three small bones in the middle ear
The three small bones carry vibrations from the eardrum to the inner ear
The cochlea is a spiral tube in the inner ear that looks like a snail
The cochlea transmits sounds to the auditory nerve
The auditory nerve sends messages to the brain
Sound travels from the pinna through the ear canal, eardrum, small bones, cochlea, and aud
Healthful habits include avoiding noisy places and consulting a doctor for ear problems
Cleaning inside the ears with cotton buds and listening at high volume can harm the ears
